controls.name: C1_random_arms_do_vary
controls.must_fire_because: the by-construction charge needs a design in which top-12 CAN vary
controls.can_fail_because: if random arms also matched, invariance would be an artefact of the fixture, not of ranked subsetting
controls.null_must_contain: random subsets of the same sizes reproducing the full set's top-12 mean exactly

controls.name: C2_scanner_detects_execution
controls.must_fire_because: an absence-of-execution probe is worthless unless it can see execution
controls.can_fail_because: an AST walk that misses ast.Import would report every file as non-executing, including one that shells out
controls.null_must_contain: a fixture that imports and calls subprocess going undetected

controls.name: C3_citation_search_finds_a_known_citation
controls.must_fire_because: an empty citation search must be distinguishable from a broken one
controls.can_fail_because: a wrong corpus root or an extension filter would return zero for every surname regardless of truth
controls.null_must_contain: the one excerpt this workspace does store going unfound by the same walk

falsifiers.name: F1_f2_expression_matches_its_reported_condition
falsifiers.can_fail_because: the comparison RESULT.md reports is absent from the f2_fires expression; it would be present if f2_fires compared the G17 arms among themselves
falsifiers.null_must_contain: an expression referencing the four G17 arms' top-12 spread
falsifiers.refutes: WITHDRAW the F2 finding if yardstick.py's f2_fires tests what RESULT.md says it tests
falsifiers.fires_when: the comparison RESULT.md reports is absent from the f2_fires expression; it would be present if f2_fires compared the G17 arms among themselves

falsifiers.name: F3_no_elder_code_executes
falsifiers.can_fail_because: no execution import and no execution call appears in the AST; a single subprocess call to a metta binary would make the differential test a real one
falsifiers.null_must_contain: a subprocess/metta/hyperon invocation in the AST
falsifiers.refutes: WITHDRAW the G29 finding if any elder code executes in diff_test.py
falsifiers.fires_when: no execution import and no execution call appears in the AST; a single subprocess call to a metta binary would make the differential test a real one

falsifiers.name: F4_literature_numbers_are_unsourced
falsifiers.can_fail_because: no surname attributed in G30's table resolves to any excerpt stored under corpus/; one stored excerpt would resolve that row
falsifiers.null_must_contain: a surname from G30's table found in corpus/
falsifiers.refutes: WITHDRAW the citation finding for any row resolving to a stored excerpt
falsifiers.fires_when: no surname attributed in G30's table resolves to any excerpt stored under corpus/; one stored excerpt would resolve that row

falsifier: G30's f2_fires tests the comparison its RESULT.md reports; or the G17 arms can differ on top-12 by construction; or elder code executes in diff_test.py; or any external row resolves to a stored citation
